tools.name: graphql-security_field-authorization-coverage
tools.description: Count object and interface fields in the supplied subgraph SDL and mark a field when its line, or its type line, contains one of the supplied directive names. Coverage is the share of marked fields. This is a text count. It does not compose a supergraph or decide whether a request would be allowed.

tools.name: graphql-security_subgraph-complexity

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "graphql-security" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: graphql-security_federation-subgraph-exposure-audit · Public sink: graphql-security_federation-authorization-audit, graphql-security_field-authorization-coverage, graphql-security_federation-subgraph-exposure-audit, graphql-security_subgraph-complexity · Destructive: graphql-security_federation-authorization-audit, graphql-security_field-authorization-coverage, graphql-security_federation-subgraph-exposure-audit, graphql-security_subgraph-complexity.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: graphql-security_federation-subgraph-exposure-audit · Public sink: graphql-security_federation-authorization-audit, graphql-security_field-authorization-coverage, graphql-security_federation-subgraph-exposure-audit, graphql-security_subgraph-complexity · Destructive: graphql-security_federation-authorization-audit, graphql-security_field-authorization-coverage, graphql-security_federation-subgraph-exposure-audit, graphql-security_subgraph-complexity

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
